title: Differential Expression and Bioinformatics Analysis of tRF/tiRNA in Endometriosis Patients.
authors: Li, Wang-Shu; Li, Yi-Lin; Cao, Rui; Ha, Chun-Fang; Sun, Shu; Yu, Lan; Li, Jian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究子宫内膜异位症中tRF/tiRNA的差异表达及靶基因预测，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Endometriosis (EMs) is a benign chronic condition that tends to recur in women of childbearing age, with an incidence of approximately 10%. It is a multifactorial disease for which the pathogenesis is currently unclear. This study is aimed at investigating the expression and clinical significance of tRNA-derived small RNA (tsRNA), a novel noncoding small RNA with potential regulatory functions, in endometriosis. METHODS: The tRF/tiRNA expression profiles in endometrial tissues from three pairs of endometriosis patients and controls were detected by tRF&tiRNA PCR microarray technology and then verified by quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qPCR). The target genes and target sites of TRF396, tiRNA-5030-GlnTTG-3, TRF308, and TRF320 were predicted by miRanda, and the network diagram of their interaction with miRNA was drawn. The impact of tRNA-derived fragments on the pathogenesis of endometriosis was analyzed using the Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG). RESULTS: Two upregulated and 19 downregulated tRNA-derived fragments were identified. The qRT-PCR results of 2 upregulated and 2 downregulated RNA-derived fragments were consistent with the RNA Seq data. The OR2B4 gene related to TRF396, the DGAT1 gene related to tiRNA-5030-GlnTTG-3, the KLF16 gene of TRF308, and the RNF213 gene of TRF320 had significant correlations. Gene Ontology and pathway analysis showed that the target genes of TRF396 and tiRNA-5030-GlnTTG-3 were mainly involved in the intrinsic components of the membrane and the overall composition of the membrane in cell components; molecular functions mainly involve olfactory conduction and G protein-coupled receptor activity. In the biological process, it was mainly involved in the detection of sensory stimuli. The target genes of TRF308 and TRF320 were mainly involved in the intracellular part; molecular functions are mainly related to DNA binding transcription factor activity and protein binding and mainly related to biological regulation of biological processes. Pathway analysis showed that the RAP1 signaling pathway and the AXON GUIDANCE signaling pathway may participate in the progression of endometriosis. CONCLUSION: The differential expression of tRF/tiRNA in endometriosis may be related to the pathogenesis of endometriosis. Furthermore, tRF/tiRNA may be a biomarker for the diagnosis and treatment of EMs in the future.
abstract_zh: 背景：子宫内膜异位症（EMs）是一种良性慢性疾病，易发于育龄期女性，发病率约为10%。它是一种多因素疾病，目前其发病机制尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨tRNA衍生小RNA（tsRNA）——一种具有潜在调控功能的新型非编码小RNA——在子宫内膜异位症中的表达及其临床意义。方法：采用tRF&tiRNA PCR微阵列技术检测三对子宫内膜异位症患者及对照组子宫内膜组织中的tRF/tiRNA表达谱，并通过实时定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）进行验证。利用miRanda预测TRF396、tiRNA-5030-GlnTTG-3、TRF308和TRF320的靶基因及靶位点，并绘制其与miRNA相互作用的网络图。通过基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）分析tRNA衍生片段对子宫内膜异位症发病机制的影响。结果：鉴定出2个上调及19个下调的tRNA衍生片段。2个上调和2个下调RNA衍生片段的qRT-PCR结果与RNA Seq数据一致。与TRF396相关的OR2B4基因、与tiRNA-5030-GlnTTG-3相关的DGAT1基因、TRF308的KLF16基因以及TRF320的RNF213基因均存在显著相关性。基因本体论和通路分析显示，TRF396和tiRNA-5030-GlnTTG-3的靶基因主要涉及膜的固有成分及细胞组分中膜的整体组成；分子功能主要涉及嗅觉传导和G蛋白偶联受体活性。在生物过程中，主要涉及感觉刺激的检测。TRF308和TRF320的靶基因主要涉及细胞内部分；分子功能主要与DNA结合转录因子活性和蛋白质结合相关，并主要与生物过程的生物调节相关。通路分析显示，RAP1信号通路和AXON GUIDANCE信号通路可能参与子宫内膜异位症的进展。结论：tRF/tiRNA在子宫内膜异位症中的差异表达可能与其发病机制相关。此外，tRF/tiRNA可能成为未来EMs诊断和治疗的生物标志物。
